integrity: Complete analytic argument with finite numerical consistency tests. Source dates are derived from verified public records; Wendel (1962-06-01) is the earliest verified public date in the archival foundation; a later 1988 article is known only by month.
scientific_limitations: Positive-curvature C3 plane curves with positive C1 boundary density; distinct fixed sites; local normal depths tending to zero. Prior article covering a more general local Poisson hull process is an unresolved bibliographic risk. No independent audit.
title: A Bessel boundary-layer law for exposed probes of random inscribed polygons
